cursor_blink.css: @keyframes cursor_blink { 0%,49% { opacity:1; } 50%,100% { opacity:0; } } .cursor { display:inline-block; width:10px; height:1.1em; background:#39FF14; vertical-align:text-bottom; margin-left:4px; animation: cursor_blink 1s steps(1) infinite; }

typewriter.css: @keyframes typewriter { from { width:0; } to { width:100%; } } .typewriter { display:inline-block; overflow:hidden; white-space:nowrap; border-right:none; animation: typewriter 2.4s steps(40,end) forwards; }

hero_fade_up.css: @keyframes fade_up { from { opacity:0; transform: translateY(24px); } to { opacity:1; transform: translateY(0); } } .hero-item { opacity:0; animation: fade_up 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1) forwards; } .hero-item:nth-child(1){animation-delay:0.1s} .hero-item:nth-child(2){animation-delay:0.3s} .hero-item:nth-child(3){animation-delay:0.5s}

project_card_slide.css: @keyframes slide_in { from { opacity:0; transform: translateX(-20px); } to { opacity:1; transform: translateX(0); } } .project-card { opacity:0; animation: slide_in 0.6s ease-out forwards; } .project-card:nth-child(1){animation-delay:0.1s} .project-card:nth-child(2){animation-delay:0.25s} .project-card:nth-child(3){animation-delay:0.4s}

link_hover.css: a { color:#39FF14; text-decoration:none; transition: color 0.2s ease, text-shadow 0.2s ease; } a:hover { text-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(57,255,20,0.5); }

home.layout: Full-bleed dark hero with terminal prompt and blinking cursor, followed by three featured project cards, tech stack icon strip, currently-building note, two recent posts, and contact CTA.

work.layout: Featured project full-width at top, then a two-column grid of project cards with screenshots, tech badges, and GitHub/demo links; open source contributions section below.

project.layout: Long-form single column with problem statement, architecture diagram, screenshots, technical decisions, metrics, and stack list with GitHub link.

writing.layout: Pinned featured post card on top, then a vertical list of posts with date, title, reading time, first line, and tag filters at the top.

about.layout: Two-column intro with photo and current role, followed by long-form opinionated prose sections on learning, building, reading, and tools, ending with contact info and resume download.
